content.comment_body: Hello, I am trying to control [product_name] Web Editor over the internet without using a VPN, since the client is a small business and prefers not to install VPN software on their network. I have attempted various solutions, including port forwarding, but accessing the [product_name] server from outside the local network still does not work. For reference, I found the router’s public IP using an online tool, then set up port forwarding from that IP to the device’s local IP (192.168.1.100). While devices inside the network connect without issues, remote devices cannot establish a connection. Any suggestions?
Be aware that opening ports to the internet can make your system vulnerable to hackers.

Yes, I am aware of the security risks. My main question is how to connect to the [product_name] Web Editor server without using a VPN, even if the security level is lower. I thought a strong password might help mitigate some risks. The client wants to access the [product_name] Web Editor remotely, similar to how they view CCTV cameras from their mobile device.

Hello [user_name], sorry for my input, but anyone experienced with security issues understands that a strong password alone won’t protect you if you leave ports open. It’s similar to installing a secure door but leaving all the windows unlocked. Customers usually aren’t comfortable with this approach.

I understand your point. Ideally, [company_name] should offer a dedicated app for [product_name] that solves this issue. Nowadays, many users expect to manage automation visually on their phones. Since [product_name] is designed for affordable automation in small businesses and homes, requiring separate VPN software for each client might be impractical.
It seems you are shifting responsibility to [company_name] for the problem...

analysis.insight_summary: The user is searching for a secure and straightforward way to remotely access and control the [product_name] Web Editor over the internet, without a VPN, as VPN setup is seen as an obstacle for small businesses. Attempts using port forwarding have failed when trying to access from outside the local network. Others caution about the significant security risks of opening ports and note that passwords alone aren't sufficient protection. The main usability issue is the absence of an officially supported and simple solution for secure remote access by non-technical users, leading to frustration and unmet requirements.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [company_name] to provide an official, user-friendly method or app that allows secure remote access to [product_name] Web Editor, without having to configure a complex VPN.
